title: Boston Blackie
paragraphs: Crime adventures featuring Boston Blackie, a former jewel thief who uses his underworld knowledge to solve cases while frequently crossing paths with police Inspector Faraday.

Crime-mystery series about reformed jewel thief Boston Blackie. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 197 dated recordings through June 15, 1949, not the full production run to 1950. Mary Wesley performer attribution is source-disputed across surviving logs, contemporary trade material, and later reference histories.

GRH documents the program through NBC West Coast summer cycle (June 23, 1944 to September 15, 1944) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], NBC Chester Morris era (June 23, 1944 to September 15, 1944) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Ziv syndicated Richard Kollmar era (April 11, 1945 to October 25, 1950).
